inputs.text: [frantic, overwhelmed, desperate, pleading to camera] There's GOT to be a better way!
[serene, blissed out, relaxed] I closed our biggest deal... from this hammock.

voice.name: Nelson - High-Pitched, Anxious Nerd
voice.about: Socially anxious nerd with expressive, slightly squeaky delivery. Great for POV skits, social media comedy, school or exam scenes, tech explainers, gaming intros, D&D characters, visual novels and any storyline that needs an overthinking, overprepared geek who still sounds lovable.
